attack165_drawing_intrusions.conclusion: Across all 752 drawing intrusions (<->), three simultaneous laws prove that illustrations were drawn BEFORE the text and reveal how the scribe navigated around them: (1) Pre-Intrusion -m Stop Suppression: Words immediately before a plant stem end in -m only 2.39% of the time vs 15.18% at true right-margin line ends (6.35x lower), proving the clause is not finished before the stem. (2) Post-Intrusion Gallows Exclusion: Words resuming on the right side of a plant stem begin with a Gallows opener (p/f/k/t) only 0.27% of the time (just 2 / 752 loci!) vs 20.84% at true left-margin line starts (77.2x lower). (3) Post-Intrusion y- Resumption Surge: Words resuming right after jumping over the plant stem begin with y- 14.49% of the time—a 4.07x surge over uninterrupted mid-line words (3.56%) that matches true line starts (14.43%)! Thus y- explicitly functions as a pen-lift / visual-jump resumption prefix ('and / continuing...').
